releaseBoundary.rule: Do not describe branch-head-only behavior as live until the exact deployed source commit is recorded.

evidenceStatuses.verified: Direct runtime, source, dated artifact or reproducible check supports the narrow claim.
evidenceStatuses.supported: First-party artifacts support the claim, but the complete real-world path was not reproduced.
evidenceStatuses.stated: The case study states the claim; adequate implementation or runtime evidence is not attached.
evidenceStatuses.missing: No adequate evidence is attached; do not publish as fact.
evidenceStatuses.notApplicable: The claim is outside this project type and the reason must be stated.

headquartersDecisionRequired.question: Until the BongFoods proof pack reaches verified status, should the Studio system become the first case shown on the work page?
headquartersDecisionRequired.recommendedAnswer: Yes. It is the strongest currently inspectable proof and keeps BongFoods visible without asking its unsupported transaction claims to carry the portfolio.
headquartersDecisionRequired.effectIfApproved: A later, separately approved public edit may reorder the existing cards. No case, route or verified implementation needs to be removed.
headquartersDecisionRequired.effectIfDeclined: Keep the present order and retain the BongFoods evidence limitations in review copy.

nextCredibleProofAsset.name: BongFoods safe commerce-flow proof pack
nextCredibleProofAsset.reason: BongFoods is the portfolio's only live founder-built commerce example and currently has the largest gap between public classification and reproducible evidence.
requiredContents: One dated 60–90 second mobile recording from the public home/menu path through cart, address and delivery-area response, stopping before any real charge.
Five annotated stills: discovery, choice, verification state, delivery-area state and payment handoff.
One contribution matrix marking each element as directed, designed, implemented, AI-assisted, platform-provided, provider-owned or not verified.
One redacted integration note naming only the provider category, test mode or live mode, reproduced step and observed result.
Three decision records covering verification timing, delivery eligibility before payment and the safest failure state.
acceptanceCriteria: The public URL and capture date are visible.
Every interaction is labelled live, test, illustrative or not reproduced.
No order is placed and no real payment, OTP, credential or private customer data is used.
The recording reaches only the last safely reproducible step.
The contribution matrix supports every retained founder-built claim.
No revenue, conversion, customer-growth or client-result claim is added.
nextCredibleProofAsset.publishableOutcomeIfPassed: A dated statement that the named public flow was reproduced through the exact final verified step.
unresolvedDependencies: Sohan must perform or supervise the founder-side capture.
A safe non-transactional or provider test path must already exist.
Any provider artifact must be redacted before it becomes portfolio evidence.
